blocks.prompt: 12. Find the equations of the circles of radius 5 that are tangent to the line \(4x + 3y - 10 = 0\) at the point \((1, 2)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan radius bhi diya hai aur line ko chhoone wala point bhi. Centre us point se normal ke saath 5 units door hoga, aur line ke dono taraf aisa ek ek point hai.
Diya kya hai? Radius 5, tangent \(4x + 3y - 10 = 0\), point of contact \((1, 2)\).
Find kya karna hai? Circles ki equations (do aayengi).
Rule kaunsa? Centre normal par, aur \(|CP| = r = 5\).
Plan: normal ki equation, \(k\) ko \(h\) mein likhna, distance 5 rakh kar \(h\).
steps:
Diya gaya: radius 5; tangent \(4x + 3y - 10 = 0\), point of contact \(P(1, 2)\).
Maloom karna: circles ki equations.
Tareeqa: Centre \(C(h, k)\) normal par hai (radius tangent par perpendicular) aur \(|CP| = 5\).

\((1, 2)\) par normal
\[4x + 3y - 10 = 0 \Rightarrow m = -\tfrac{4}{3}\]
\[y - 2 = \tfrac{3}{4}(x - 1)\]
\[3x - 4y + 5 = 0\]
Kyun: Pehle check: \(4 + 6 - 10 = 0\), point line par hai. Line ka slope \(-\frac{4}{3}\), normal ka ulta aur sign badla hua \(\frac{3}{4}\).

Centre normal par
\[k - 2 = \tfrac{3}{4}(h - 1)\]
Kyun: \(C(h, k)\) normal ki equation ko satisfy karta hai. Humne usay point-slope shakal mein hi rakha, kyunke agle qadam mein \((k - 2)\) ki jagah seedha \(\frac{3}{4}(h - 1)\) rakhna hai aur is se ek hi variable \(h\) bachega.

\(|CP| = 5\) lagayein
\[(h - 1)^2 + (k - 2)^2 = 25\]
\[(h - 1)^2 + \tfrac{9}{16}(h - 1)^2 = 25\]
\[\tfrac{25}{16}(h - 1)^2 = 25\]
\[(h - 1)^2 = 16,\quad h - 1 = \pm 4\]
Kyun: \((k - 2)^2 = \frac{9}{16}(h - 1)^2\) rakha; \(1 + \frac{9}{16} = \frac{25}{16}\). Square root par \(\pm\) dono lene hain, kyunke centre line ke dono taraf ho sakta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{|20 + 15 - 10|}{5} = 5,\quad \dfrac{|-12 - 3 - 10|}{5} = 5\]
Kyun: Dono centres line se 5 units door hain, yani line dono ko chhooti hai. Mazedaar baat: \((1, 2)\) dono centres \((5, 5)\) aur \((-3, -1)\) ka bilkul midpoint hai.
Dhyan dein: Ek hi circle likh kar ruk jana aam ghalti hai; sawal mein "circles" likha hai.
